[tp-asciidoc-viewer%allow-script,label="tp-kakuro"]
========
[script,type="tp/asciidoc"]
----
.Basic usage
======
[tp-kakuro]
====
. `# 23/0 30/0 # # 27/0 12/0 16/0`

. `0/16 . . # 17/24 . . .`

. `0/17 . . 15/29 . . . .`

. `0/35 . . . . . 12/0 #`

. `# 0/7 . . 7/8 . . 7/0`

. `# 11/0 10/16 . . . . .`

. `0/21 . . . . 0/5 . .`

. `0/6 . . . # 0/3 . .`
====
======

.Javascript API
======
[script,type="module"]
====
import "/components/kakuro/kakuro.js";

const example = document.createDocumentFragment();

const element1 = document.createElement("tp-kakuro");
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));

const element2 = document.createElement("ol");
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n    "));

const element3 = document.createElement("li");

const element4 = document.createElement("code");
element4.append(document.createTextNode("# 23/0 30/0 # # 27/0 12/0 16/0"));
element3.append(element4);
element2.append(element3);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n    "));

const element5 = document.createElement("li");

const element6 = document.createElement("code");
element6.append(document.createTextNode("0/16 . . # 17/24 . . ."));
element5.append(element6);
element2.append(element5);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n    "));

const element7 = document.createElement("li");

const element8 = document.createElement("code");
element8.append(document.createTextNode("0/17 . . 15/29 . . . ."));
element7.append(element8);
element2.append(element7);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n    "));

const element9 = document.createElement("li");

const element10 = document.createElement("code");
element10.append(document.createTextNode("0/35 . . . . . 12/0 #"));
element9.append(element10);
element2.append(element9);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n    "));

const element11 = document.createElement("li");

const element12 = document.createElement("code");
element12.append(document.createTextNode("# 0/7 . . 7/8 . . 7/0"));
element11.append(element12);
element2.append(element11);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n    "));

const element13 = document.createElement("li");

const element14 = document.createElement("code");
element14.append(document.createTextNode("# 11/0 10/16 . . . . ."));
element13.append(element14);
element2.append(element13);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n    "));

const element15 = document.createElement("li");

const element16 = document.createElement("code");
element16.append(document.createTextNode("0/21 . . . . 0/5 . ."));
element15.append(element16);
element2.append(element15);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n    "));

const element17 = document.createElement("li");

const element18 = document.createElement("code");
element18.append(document.createTextNode("0/6 . . . # 0/3 . ."));
element17.append(element18);
element2.append(element17);
element2.append(document.createTextNode("\n  "));
element1.append(element2);
element1.append(document.createTextNode("\n"));
example.append(element1);

document.body.append(example);
